title: Local food tour in Barcelona
text: The tour was amazing a real Catalan experience, great food and ambience, and Montse our guide she was just great. Highly recommended for those that want to get to know better the culture food and meet a local people.
author: camiloh298

title: Excellent!
text: Montse's guide on the tapas tour was excellent both in her treatment and regarding her orientation, knowledge, and explanations about the food and the markets we visited.
author: astridmO7991TD

title: A very rich and highly recommended tour.
text: We really liked the places the guide took us to, the explanation was very good, and we learned a lot. We ate very well and the drinks were of very good quality.
author: M7487YVveronicac

title: Tapas walking and wine tasting toùr
text: This tour was extremely fascinating.  Montse is very knowledgeable and exuberant.  We loved her energy.  She gave us such comprehensive history. She educated us on foods, history, etc.
author: Discover12461628323

title: Boqueria & St Caterina Markets with Food & Tapas tour
text: Montse was AMAZING!  She was very passionate and familiar with the tour of the markets and the area.  She gave great suggestions for restaurants and areas to go to beyond the tour.  Definitely loves what she does! We saw amazing things and ate great food.
author: Cindy C

title: Walking city and food tour
text: Our tour guide, Andre was fantastic! Great tour of the city and wonderful food. He did an amazing job showing us sights we wouldn't have found on our own.
author: susandL8259WJ

title: Outstanding tour
text: Montse was very knowledgeable and informative during the tour. Additionally she was energetic and was able to secure food and drink for us wherever she decided to visit.
author: Craig_W

title: Excellent, knowledgeable
text: Montse was a wonderful tour guide, she was a wealth of knowledge on Barcelona and the markets. She went above and beyond the usual tour guide and sent us additional information on things we had questions about.
author: Michele K

title: Amazing food tour
text: Montse was an excellent guide. She was super informative and we were able to try a great variety of foods at La Boqueria including an amazing tortilla espanola, paella and Catalan version of octopus and cod. We also tried some great cava, churros and chocolate and amazing cheese in addition to learning a lot about Catalan culture. Definitely recommend!
author: Y6680BFmegang

title: Food Tour
text: The tour was very informative and a culinary delight. Our tour guide Montse showed us many sights that we didn't know about.
author: NorthStar23505131766
